# Gemini model fallback chain for the nightly AI review.
# Models are tried in order — first success wins.
# On 404 (model unavailable) or 429 (quota exceeded) the next model is tried.
# Update this list when models are deprecated or better ones become available.

# Primary: deep architectural reasoning, 1M token context
gemini-3.1-pro-preview

# Fallback 1: optimised for software engineering tasks
gemini-3.7-flash

# Fallback 2: cost/quota reduction
gemini-3.5-flash

# Fallback 3: minimal token consumption
gemini-3.5-flash-lite
